title: Chris Liddell appointed to Anthropic's board
summary: Former Microsoft and GM CFO Chris Liddell joins Anthropic's Board of Directors alongside Dario and Daniela Amodei, Jay Kreps, and Reed Hastings.
body: Former Microsoft and GM CFO Chris Liddell joins Anthropic's Board of Directors alongside Dario and Daniela Amodei, Jay Kreps, and Reed Hastings.
